text: Hello, neighbours! I'm Ada, and I keep bees, so I know the apple trees well. Come spring, their blossoms are the first big feast for my hives, and the bees pay them back by pollinating every flower. A good orchard hums all April long, and in autumn the apples taste a little of that honey sweetness.
